name: Worktree name
rename_hint: This changes the worktree name. Agent names stay the same.
read_only: Full device access is required to change worktrees.
owner_changed: The connection or manager changed. Open the actions again.
invalidated: This destination or its availability changed. Close and review the current workspace before continuing.
unavailable: This workspace or its engine is unavailable.
protected: The main checkout cannot be deleted.
has_children: Remove child worktrees before deleting this parent.
rename_unknown: The rename is not confirmed. Check the current worktree name before trying again.
preview_invalid: The deletion preview does not match this workspace. Close and review the current workspace.
sessions_end: Running agents and terminals in this workspace will end.
folder_kept: Only the folder workspace entry is removed. Its directory and files are kept.
files_deleted: The checkout directory and its files will be deleted.
dirty_one: {count} file has uncommitted changes. Those changes will be lost.
dirty_other: {count} files have uncommitted changes. Those changes will be lost.
delete_branch: Also delete the local branch if merged
keep_branch: The branch is kept by default. Unmerged branches are always kept.
unknown: Removal is not confirmed. This workspace stays here until its status is checked. No deletion will be sent again.
close_keeps_files: The directory, files and Git branches are kept.
linked_only: Linked Git worktrees can be deleted. This workspace can be closed.
